metadata.title: Analyze Affected System
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Analyze the current system (codebase AND gathered information) to identify affected components, dependencies, patterns, and impact areas for implementing a user story. Use before creating LLD to understand what needs to change.

output.description: Structured impact assessment stored in memory

prerequisites: User story or feature description available
Gathered information available from gather-relevant-information step
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: understand scope → review gathered info → validate sources → identify entry points → map components → analyze dependencies → find patterns → assess impact → document
Substep 3 is a validation checkpoint - if sources missing, exit and return to gather-relevant-information
Analyze both codebase AND gathered information from various sources
Sources include: codebase, external services, infrastructure, package dependencies (NuGet/NPM), documentation

update: memory.json (current step section with analysis results)

tools: read_file - Read process context, memory, package files
codebase_search - Find related code and patterns
grep - Search for specific patterns or references
bestPractices: Always validate source coverage before deep analysis
Consider all source types: codebase, external services, infrastructure, packages, docs
Map both upstream (what calls) and downstream (what is called) dependencies
Include package dependencies (NuGet, NPM) in analysis
Categorize impacts by layer (API/service/data) and type (new/modify/extend)
Note cross-cutting concerns: security, logging, monitoring
Keep memory output structured and organized by category

substeps.name: Understand user story scope
substeps.description: Read user story and identify functionality being added/changed
actions: Read process parameters
Understand what the feature does
Identify core functionality

substeps.name: Review gathered information
substeps.description: Analyze information collected in previous step (gather-relevant-information)
actions: Read gatheredInformation from memory.json
Identify relevant external services/APIs from documentation
Note infrastructure components mentioned (databases, queues, caches)
Review wikis/markdown for system architecture context
List external touchpoints that may be affected

substeps.name: Validate source coverage
substeps.description: Check if critical sources are available for analysis
substeps.exitCondition: If sources are missing, exit step and return to gather-relevant-information
actions: Check if user story scope requires external service information - verify it's in gathered info
Check if infrastructure documentation is needed - verify it's available
Check if package/dependency info is accessible (package.json, *.csproj exist)
Identify any critical gaps that would prevent accurate analysis
If gaps found: document missing sources in memory, set returnToPreviousStep flag, exit step
If sources sufficient: continue to next substep

exitOutput.missingSources: Array of missing source categories with descriptions
exitOutput.reason: Description of why sources are needed

substeps.name: Identify entry points
substeps.description: Find where the change originates in our system
actions: Identify API endpoints, UI components, jobs, or events that trigger the functionality

substeps.name: Map affected components
substeps.description: Trace through codebase AND external systems to find all affected areas
actions: Use codebase_search to find related code
List controllers/services/repositories affected
Identify external services that need changes or new integrations
Note infrastructure components affected (DB schemas, queues, etc.)

substeps.name: Analyze dependencies
substeps.description: Map internal, external, AND package dependencies
actions: Find what calls affected components (upstream - internal)
Find what affected components call (downstream - internal)
Identify external service dependencies (APIs we call)
Identify services that depend on us (APIs we expose)
Note infrastructure dependencies
Check package dependencies: read package.json, *.csproj, packages.config
Identify new packages needed (NuGet, NPM, etc.)
Identify existing packages that may need version updates
Note any package compatibility concerns

substeps.name: Find existing patterns
substeps.description: Search for similar implementations in codebase and documentation
actions: Identify how similar features are implemented
Note conventions and patterns to follow
Check gathered documentation for architectural patterns
Review how similar packages are used in the codebase

substeps.name: Assess impact areas
substeps.description: Categorize all impacts by area and type
actions: Categorize codebase impact by layer (API/service/data)
Categorize by change type (new/modify/extend)
List external services impact (new integrations/changes)
List infrastructure impact (DB changes, new queues, etc.)
List package dependency impact (new packages, version updates, removals)
List documentation needing updates (wikis, READMEs, API docs)
Note cross-cutting concerns (security, logging, monitoring)

substeps.name: Document findings
actions: Structure findings in memory.json
Include: affectedComponents, externalSystemsImpact, packageDependencies, dependencies, existingPatterns, impactAreas
Organize impactAreas by category: codebase, externalServices, infrastructure, packages, documentation

flow.description: Linear flow with conditional exit at substep 3. Substeps 1-2 gather context, substep 3 validates sources (exit if missing), substeps 4-8 perform analysis, substep 9 documents findings.

fields: Information Produced: affectedComponents, externalSystemsImpact, packageDependencies, dependencies, existingPatterns, impactAreas, analysisNotes
Decisions Made: Component selection, dependency categorization, pattern identification

structure: Array of component names/paths with change description
Array of external system names with impact description

feedbackLoop.description: If analysis reveals information gaps, return to gather-relevant-information to collect missing data
